value.rationale: The optimized quotient and Euclidean comparison are well-posed for this natural plane. But as a new contribution the upper value and rigidity are inherited, the restricted quartic is obtained by a literal four-cycle count with two weights, and the distance is an instance of a known profile. Endpoint comparisons, square completion, and monotonicity and the limit of the specialized rational parameter do not supply a separately motivated unknown invariant beyond those formulae. The frozen claim can be useful as a worked specialization, not as an independent finding under the value standard.
